title: Witnessed refinement inverse equals the canonical directed comparison
statement: Fix finite-field data D, coefficient data C, a finite extension E/Q_l and level n+1. For finite-type quasi-compact schemes X,Y over D.k, a quasi-compact morphism f, a proper compactification refinement r:c→d, an arbitrary derived fixed-scalar object K, a retained bounded-below etale origin O and an isomorphism fixed(O)≅K, the inverse of the specified witnessed theta_r(K,O,e) equals RefinementProjection.finiteComparison D A r K. This concerns only the proper/open mate and the canonical direct-image compositor, with no tensor, projection map, constructibility or Tor-amplitude hypotheses.

source.place: Compactification refinement and independence; detailed argument of lem-sf-projection-refinement-descent

proof.text: Apply the existing generic theorem CompactSupportFiniteProjection.refinementComparisonAtWitness_inv_eq at the actual finite coefficient ring and retained origin O. It identifies the inverse specified refinementComparisonAtWitness with finiteComparison at refinementFixedObject, with the same hypotheses and no absolute separatedness assumption. That theorem supplies the site-word, bounded-below inclusion, witness normalization, compositor conjugacy and index-transport calculation of the original plan.

Package the exact three factors of finiteComparison as the private natural transformation comparisonNat: whisker the identity-normalized proper/open mate by the outer proper direct image, then whisker the conjugate compositor and indexIso by the first open extension. Its component is definitionally finiteComparison, as proved by comparisonNat_app. The generic categorical lemma inverseIsoTransport says that conjugating an inverse component by e and e inverse equals its component at the transported object: naturality moves e through the transformation and functoriality cancels e inverse followed by e.

The private comparison_transport theorem combines the existing retained-origin normalization with inverseIsoTransport. Specialize its generic coefficient ring to Coefficient C.l E n, with the specified discrete topology. The inverse of theta is definitionally the transported isomorphism in comparison_transport, so this proves normalized_refinement_inverse with its original signature. No tensor or projection map is inverted, and the same naturality cancellation covers identity refinements, empty schemes, and zero objects.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_refinement_inverse
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[C.l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[C.l] E]
    (n : ℕ) {X Y : Spaces D} {f : X ⟶ Y} [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    {c d : Compactification f.hom.left} (r : c.Refinement d)
    (K : ProperOpenDerived (Coefficient C.l E n) X.obj.left)
    (O : RefinementFiniteLevelOrigin C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X.obj.left)
    (e : refinementFiniteLevelFixedObject C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X.obj.left O ≅ K) :
    (theta C.l E n r K O e).inv =
      RefinementProjection.finiteComparison D (Coefficient C.l E n) r K
